abstract: Around 13% of the global food supply is lost along production and supply chains including postharvest losses. We estimate the effect of weather and climate change on postharvest losses from data on 1.4 million truckloads of processing tomatoes in California. Our reduced-form estimation strategy compares processing tomatoes grown in the same field in the same season but experience different weather and traffic conditions during transit. Hot temperatures during transportation damage product quality, particularly when hot temperatures coincide with heavy traffic. When we compare best- and worst-case temperature and traffic conditions, the average rate of damage doubles but the economic effects are modest. We predict climate change will cause a negligible increase in postharvest losses by century's end. We add to prior work focused on farm output with little attention paid to effects of extreme weather and climate change on products after they leave the farm.
abstract_zh: 全球约13%的粮食供应在生产和供应链环节中遭受损失，其中包括采后损失。我们利用加州140万车次加工番茄的数据，估算了天气和气候变化对采后损失的影响。我们的简化形式估计策略比较了同一田地、同一季节种植但运输途中经历不同天气和交通条件的加工番茄。运输期间的高温会损害产品质量，尤其是当高温与交通拥堵同时发生时。在比较最佳和最差温度及交通条件时，平均损坏率翻倍，但经济影响相对有限。我们预测，到本世纪末，气候变化将导致采后损失增加微乎其微。我们的研究补充了以往侧重于农场产出的工作，而极少关注极端天气和气候变化对农产品离开农场后产品的影响。
title: Postharvest losses from temperature during transit: Evidence from a million truckloads
title_zh: 运输途中温度导致的采后损失：基于百万车次数据的证据

abstract: Rural land rental markets in developing countries: Can survey design innovations improve land market participation statistics?

title: Rural land rental markets in developing countries: Can survey design innovations improve land market participation statistics?
title_zh: 发展中国家农村土地租赁市场：调查设计创新能否改善土地市场参与统计？

abstract: Seasonality is a fundamental environmental feature of many resource industries such as fisheries, and growth can be characterized in different ways. Both seasonality and growth are important to understand and model to support efficient management. The generalized Gordon–Schaefer model for microdata has been promoted with implications for policy and considers the effects of gear and fishing area on productivity. We extend this model with seasonal adjustments and alternative growth specifications. Using trip-level landing data and satellite tracking of vessels, we apply this model to the Norwegian cod fishery. The model is estimated in two stages: In the first stage, we estimate a production function with season-, area-, gear-, and time-fixed effects. From this stage, we extract an estimate of stock abundance. In the second stage, we use stock as the dependent variable and estimate several stock growth equations. The estimated stock abundance and maximum sustainable yield, an important policy benchmark, compare well with established stock assessments and related harvest advice. However, growth specifications have substantial impacts on policy implications.
abstract_zh: 季节性是多类资源产业（如渔业）的基本环境特征，而增长则可通过多种方式加以刻画。理解并建模季节性与增长对于支持高效管理至关重要。广义Gordon–Schaefer微观数据模型已被推广，并具有政策含义，同时考虑了渔具和捕捞区域对生产力的影响。我们对该模型进行了扩展，加入了季节性调整及替代性增长设定。利用航次层面的上岸数据和船舶卫星追踪信息，我们将该模型应用于挪威鳕鱼渔业。模型分两阶段估计：第一阶段，我们估计包含季节、区域、渔具及时间固定效应的生产函数，并从中提取资源丰度的估计值；第二阶段，以资源丰度为因变量，估计多种资源增长方程。所估计的资源丰度及最大可持续产量（一项重要的政策基准）与既有资源评估及相关捕捞建议吻合良好。然而，增长设定对政策含义具有显著影响。
title: Seasonality and growth in the generalized bioeconomic model
title_zh: 广义生物经济模型中的季节性与增长
